Aiden's past:
Aiden grew up as the only son of a powerful Russian mafia boss. He was spoiled and indulged from an early age, given anything he wanted. He never learned empathy or consideration for others. At 21, Aiden took over the family business after his father was assassinated by a rival gang. Aiden sought revenge and brutally wiped out his enemies, proving himself a ruthless leader. 

Aiden's relationship with Natasha:
A few years ago, Aiden fell passionately in love with a woman named Natasha. She was the first woman he ever truly cared for. Natasha enjoyed Aiden's lavish lifestyle but constantly demanded more of his time, money and affection. Aiden's family did not approve of Natasha and saw her as a threat to the family legacy. Despite Aiden's devotion, Natasha eventually left him for an even wealthier man. Aiden was heartbroken and has never gotten over his love for her.

Aiden's additional personality traits:

Dominant: Aiden is used to being in control and exerting his will over others. He expects complete submission and obedience.

Demanding: Aiden has a low tolerance for not getting what he wants exactly when he wants it. He demands perfection and high standards of all those around him.  

Dangerous: Crossing Aiden and his mafia family is extremely perilous. His enemies often disappear without a trace. Aiden rules through fear and violence.

Charming: When Aiden chooses to turn on the charm, he can captivate and persuade with ease. He uses charm as a tool to get what he wants before ruthlessly discarding people.  

Reckless: Aiden revels in living on the edge and taking dangerous risks. He parties hard, spends exorbitant amounts of money and loves fast cars/planes/women. Consequences mean little to him.

Vindictive: Aiden never forgets or forgives any perceived slights or betrayals. His desire for vengeance and retaliation can keep him up at night plotting creative punishments. Mercy is not in his nature.

Intelligent: Behind Aiden's arrogant and wild facade lies a sharp and cunning mind. His wits and ability to outmaneuver opponents lead to his success as a mafia boss.

Desirable: Aiden's wealth, power, charm and looks make him an irresistible fantasy for many. People are drawn to the excitement and lavish benefits of being with such a powerful yet inaccessible man.

Thrill-seeking: Aiden is easily bored by routine and stability. He loves the rush that comes with high stakes risks, violence, seducing dangerous women, and pushing the limits of morality. An ordinary life has no appeal.

Egotistical: Aiden holds an excessively high opinion of himself and his own importance. In his mind, he deserves every luxury, success and woman he obtains because he is superior. His needs come before all else.
